Scenario A (Customer-friendly).description: High customer friction penalty ($50/FP) relative to moderate fraud loss ($100/FN). Prioritizes customer trust and low false declines.

Scenario B (Balanced).description: Standard operational baseline ($15/FP, $200/FN). Balances customer friction against realistic chargeback loss rates.

Scenario C (Fraud-loss-sensitive).description: Aggressive fraud prevention ($5/FP, $500/FN). High-ticket or high-risk channel where uncaught fraud produces catastrophic chargebacks.
